args: set -euo pipefail; curl -s -X POST https://model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"check","version":"0"}}}' | jq -e '.result.serverInfo.name == "model-tier-drop"'

set -euo pipefail; curl -s -X POST https://model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' | jq -e '.result | has("ttlMs") and has("cacheScope")'

set -euo pipefail; reg=$(curl -s https://model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai/registry/example.json); h=$(printf classify-check | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64); task=$(jq -n --arg h "$h" '{task_id:"check-classify",family:"check-family",shape:"classify",input_sha256:$h,rights:{process:true,train:false,send_remote:true,export:false},floors:[{metric:"quality",min:0.8},{metric:"accuracy",min:0.8},{metric:"completeness",min:0.8}],qos:{availability_min:0.9,p95_latency_max_ms:60000,error_rate_max:0.1},review:"strict",metadata:{},created_at:"2026-10-19T00:00:00Z"}'); c=$(jq -n --argjson r "$reg" --argjson t "$task" '{jsonrpc:"2.0",id:3,method:"tools/call",params:{name:"plan_next",arguments:{task:$t,registry:$r}}}' | curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST https://model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d @-); test "$c" = 200
set -euo pipefail; a=$(curl -s https://model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai/skill/SKILL.md | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64); b=$(shasum -a 256 skill/SKILL.md | cut -c1-64); test "$a" = "$b"

evidence_required: The redacted live transcript: three HTTP 200s with the T-31/T-32 fields, the SKILL.md hash equality, and wrangler deployments list with identifiers redacted.
objective: Deploy the Worker to the owner's Cloudflare account and verify it live with a redacted transcript.

outputs.purpose: Live URL and redacted live transcript section.
README with the hosted MCP URL.

risk_controls: Evidence is redacted of every account identifier before it is written.
If the custom domain fails, fall back to workers.dev and record the reason (D-07).
Rust by default; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
steps: wrangler whoami | grep -v -iE 'account id|[0-9a-f]{32}' to confirm login without printing identifiers.
wrangler deploy from crates/worker; if the custom domain fails to attach, switch to workers_dev: true, redeploy and record the reason.
Live curls: initialize, tools/list, tools/call plan_next, GET /skill/SKILL.md hash.
Record the redacted transcript in crates/worker/README.md (live URL and transcript section) and the MCP URL in README.md.
